Element.attribute: Smaller projects require the same project management rigor as larger projects but often do not have temporal gap that exists between formal initiate and plan processes because of their short duration.  Those processes have been consolidated into a 'Start up and Preparation' process group. Delivery, monitoring and control and close process groups have been consolidated to facilitate team assignments and coverage while retaining rigor.
To define the exact tasks and activities that will be taking place for the goals and the scope of the project to be achieved.

Element.Name: startup_prep_proj
Element.DisplayName: Start up and Prepare the Project
Element.attribute: Start up and Prepare the Project

Define a new project or phase by obtaining authorization to start the project or phase and establish the scope of the project, refine the objectives, and define the course of action required to attain project objectives.

Element.Name: execute_proj
Element.attribute: Deliver the work defined in the project management plan to satisfy the project specifications.

Element.Name: monitor_ctrl_proj
Element.attribute: Track, review, and regulate the progress and performance of the project; identify any areas in which changes to the plan are required; and initiate the corresponding changes.

Element.Name: close_proj
Element.attribute: Finalize all activities across all areas to formally close the project or phase.
